backup.restore_point: PENDING - name the backup set taken before this apply
backup.production_rule: Replaces one function body with CREATE OR REPLACE. No table, column, policy or grant changes. The prior body is recoverable from this file's git history as well as from the named backup set.

rollback.safe_until: always - one function body, no data touched

steps.name: restore_the_previous_body
steps.action: Re-apply the prior verify_turnover definition, which is preserved in git history immediately before this migration. No data migration is involved.

compatibility.evidence: Same signature and same return shape; one new early return adds the issue code 'no_checkout_scheduled' with check_passed true. The only caller, turnover-verifier pass 1, is updated in the same change to skip alerting on that code; pass 2 already gates on check_passed and needs no change. The migration asserts all three live cases inside the apply transaction, so a wrong result rolls back.

stop_conditions: any assertion in the migration's DO block raises - in particular, 2026-09-07 must still fail as a real missed turnover
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the turnover-verifier edge function must be deployed in the same window, or the false alarms continue despite the fix
